Audit Findings.title: Review of policies and procedures

findings.title: Outdated document control procedure not aligned with current process
findings.description: uring review of the Document Control Procedure (DOC-001, Rev 3), it was found that the procedure references an approval workflow that was discontinued in Q1 2026. Three policy documents (HR-Policy-04, IT-Policy-02, QA-Policy-07) were approved using the outdated workflow, bypassing the current two-stage sign-off requirement.
findings.rootCauseDetail: The procedure update following the Q1 2026 workflow change was not communicated to document owners, and the master procedure document was not revised accordingly
findings.recommendation: Revise DOC-001 to reflect the current two-stage approval workflow; re-issue for approval; retrain document owners on the updated process; re-approve the three affected policies under the correct workflow.
findings.managementResponse: Agreed. QA team will revise and re-issue DOC-001 by 15 Sep 2026, followed by a mandatory refresher training session for all document owners. The three affected policies will be re-routed for approval under the correct workflow by the target resolution date.

issues.title: No formal policy governing third-party data sharing
issues.description: The current policy library does not include a dedicated Third-Party Data Sharing Policy. Several departments (HR, Sales, IT) share data with external vendors based on informal, undocumented practices, creating inconsistency in data handling standards and potential regulatory exposure.
issues.recommendation: Draft and implement a formal Third-Party Data Sharing Policy covering vendor risk assessment, data classification, and contractual data protection clauses. Conduct a review of all existing third-party data flows against the new policy.
issues.managementResponse: Agreed. Legal and IT Security will co-draft the policy by 30 Sep 2026, with rollout and department briefings completed by the target resolution date. An interim data-sharing checklist will be issued in the meantime to reduce immediate risk.

findings.title: Missing signatures on Medication Administration Records (MAR)
findings.description: Review of 15 resident medication folders identified 4 instances where MAR charts had missing staff signatures following medication administration, with no documented reason (e.g., refusal, withheld) recorded. Gaps were found across morning and evening shifts over the past two weeks.
findings.rootCauseDetail: Staff are not consistently completing MAR sign-off immediately after administration, particularly during high-workload shift changes. No secondary check is in place to catch missed entries in real time.
findings.recommendation: Reinforce medication administration protocol requiring immediate MAR sign-off; introduce end-of-shift double-check by senior staff; retrain all care staff on MAR documentation requirements; conduct spot-checks weekly for the next month.
findings.managementResponse: Agreed. Refresher training on MAR documentation will be delivered to all care staff by 10 Aug 2026. A shift-handover checklist including MAR verification will be introduced immediately, and weekly spot-audits will be conducted by the Care Home Manager for one month to confirm compliance.

Audit Findings.title: Review of Organisational Manual

findings.title: Organisational chart in manual does not reflect current reporting structure
findings.description: The organisational chart included in the Organisational Manual (Section 2, Page 8) shows an outdated reporting structure. Two department head roles created during the 2026 restructuring are not reflected, and one listed role (Regional Coordinator) was discontinued in January 2026 but still appears as active.
findings.rootCauseDetail: The Organisational Manual was not updated following the internal restructuring; there is no defined trigger or ownership for updating the manual when organisational changes occur.
findings.recommendation: Update the organisational chart and related role descriptions to reflect the current structure; establish a formal trigger requiring HR to notify the Document Controller of any structural change within 5 working days, with the manual updated accordingly.
findings.managementResponse: Agreed. HR will provide the current organisational structure to the Document Controller by 20 Aug 2026 for immediate update. A standing procedure will be added to the change management process to ensure the manual is updated within 5 working days of any future restructuring.
